description: Explain what a value of an element or attribute means in a BREX, or list the allowed values. Pass "target" as an attribute name (e.g. "securityClassification"), an element name, or an XPath fragment; optionally "value" to check one value. Returns the matching rules with allowed values and their meanings, and whether the value is allowed.

brex.description: Which BREX to use: a file path to a BREX data module (.xml), or a DMC (e.g. "KENBAIKI-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D", "DMC-" prefix optional) searched in csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR / S1000D_SPEC_DIR. Omit to use the S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR.

context.description: Schema file name (e.g. "descript") to pick context-specific rules in addition to common ones.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

target.description: Attribute name ("infoCode", "@infoCode"), element name ("language"), or XPath fragment to match against objectPath.

value.description: The value to check against the allowed values (optional).

name: lookup_value
